newsitem.title: FRANCE: Four fall to their death in French mountains.
newsitem.headline: Four fall to their death in French mountains.

text.p: Four French climbers and hikers fell to their deaths in separate accidents at the weekend, police said on Sunday.

In the Alps, an experienced 30-year-old climber fell 80 metres (260 ft) from the spectacular thorn-shaped Dibona peak in the Oisans range. Two hikers, one of them aged 72, died in falls in the Savoy region.
And in the central Auvergne region, a climbing instructor fell to his death on the Puy-de-Sancy mountain.
Some 50 people have died in a rash of climbing or hiking accidents in the Alps since mid-July.
